# GPT Image 2.6 markup edits — circle one spot, change only that part

**Circles, boxes, arrows and notes on a transparent layer tell GPT Image 2.6 to change only the marked spots of an image.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_fad6e6a57231.webp" alt="A cosy armchair scene with a sleeping cat gets red and blue circles drawn on it, then crossfades into the GPT Image 2.6 edit that follows the markup." width="480"></p>

Markup-guided image edits with GPT Image 2.6 on varg: draw circles, boxes, arrows and short notes on a transparent PNG the same size as the source (scripts/markup.py turns a JSON list of shapes into that PNG, a preview and the prompt lines), upload it, then edit with provider_options.fal.markup_image_url and a prompt written per colour ("Red circle: … Blue circle: … Change nothing outside the marks."). Includes the measured example (two changes, the rest of the frame kept), how to check what changed, and when to use a black-and-white mask_url instead. Use when someone wants to change one or several specific spots in an image, says "circle it", "only change this part", "fix this word", "add a hat here", or an edit keeps changing things it should not. Not for whole-image restyles (gpt-image-2-6 recipes), animation (gpt-image-gif) or video edits (varg-ai).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill gpt-image-markup-edit                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills gpt-image-markup-edit --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Put a party hat on the dog in ./dog.png and change nothing else: circle its head"
- "Fix the misspelled word on the shop sign in ./storefront.jpg without touching the rest of the photo"
- "In ./desk.png turn the red mug blue and replace the plant on the left with a lamp, using two colored circles"
